snippet.title: Corpus et Spiritus - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder without combat. You signed a pact with a Homunculus, and it was a bad idea. Use your workshop to craft new cards, transmute metals and discover magical talismans. Become smarter than your dangerous partner and break out of the pact before it kills you!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4225280/Corpus_et_Spiritus/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_medium=trailer

Sound by Pierre-François Renouf and music by Nicolas Cornil, from Studio Le Refuge - https://www.studiolerefuge.fr/
